name: deskmate
description: A Live2D or 3D (VRM / MMD) AI desk companion that lives on your screen and talks back: speech to speech with a local Whisper + Kokoro voice, sees what you do, drives your Chrome, hands real work to Claude Code, dances when you ask, remembers you. Runs fully local with Ollama, or on Gemini.

scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-electron.cjs && node scripts/build-hands.cjs && electron-vite dev
scripts.build: node scripts/ensure-electron.cjs && node scripts/build-hands.cjs && electron-vite build
scripts.start: node scripts/ensure-electron.cjs && node scripts/build-hands.cjs && electron-vite preview
scripts.dist: node scripts/ensure-electron.cjs && node scripts/build-hands.cjs --universal && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/ensure-electron.cjs && node scripts/build-hands.cjs --universal && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --mac && node scripts/smoke-package.cjs
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/ensure-electron.cjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --win
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/ensure-electron.cjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --linux
scripts.pack: node scripts/ensure-electron.cjs && node scripts/build-hands.cjs --universal && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --dir
